slides.texte_overlay:
Things that make a man
great to work with
He answers clearly and quickly. Even "I'll get back to you Friday" is better than silence. People love working with someone who never leaves them waiting.
He owns his mistakes. "That's on me, here's the fix." No blaming, no hiding. Colleagues trust the man who makes problems smaller, never bigger, under pressure.
He shares credit generously. "Sara did the hard part on this." Lifting others up costs nothing and makes everyone want to be on his team next time.
He brings solutions, not just problems. "This won't work, but what if we tried this?" Being constructive is what makes people truly value your opinion.
He brings fresh ideas. I do five minutes a day of history, art or science, and examples from other fields keep my ideas original and useful at work.
slides.texte_sophia: I do five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. Examples from other fields keep my ideas original at work.

slides.texte_overlay: He respects people's time. Meetings start on time, end early, and have a clear point. Everyone notices the man who never wastes their whole afternoon.
He stays calm under pressure. Deadlines, angry clients, last-minute changes. A steady colleague makes the whole team feel calmer and more capable.
